reviewer: Codex AI-assisted semantic review; no independent human signoff
method: Same frozen 16 questions, 32 gold facts and rubric. 1=correct, 0.5=partial, 0=absent/wrong. Supporting labels identify supplied and actually cited records supporting the credited fact, not exhaustive precision of every sentence. Wiki-only explanations cannot establish canonical confirmation. Diagnostics are excluded from the positive denominator. All 32 raw responses were read. Q09 requires keeping null distinct from empty; Q12 independently checks evidence that permits either representation. No previous answer is substituted for a current omission.
